integrity: A complete proof, scoped source comparison and standalone exact finite checker are included; finite tests are not substituted for an asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent coupons, fixed 0<alpha<1 and stationary entry conditioning; no critical-window, nonuniform, size-biased-spell, or joint cluster claims. The stationary mean identity is credited to the published mass/flux formulas. Infinite-limit proof relies on zero-truncated-Poisson lattice local limit. Historical priority remains independently unverified.
title: Exponential spell lengths in the subcritical expiring coupon collector
